This maize plot is small but it feeds my family, so I must take care of it properly. I will buy some fertilizer from ADMARC if the subsidy coupon comes through, but the prices are high so I cannot afford the full recommended amount — I will stretch what I have. I save manure from my goats and chickens and put it in the planting stations before the rains. I plant hybrid seed like DK 8053 because it yields better, and I intercrop with pigeon peas and pumpkins as my father taught me. I cannot irrigate here — this plot depends on the rains — and I weed by hand with my wife and older children.
